name: Millet Pancake
ingredients_raw: Supergrain blend (69%) (jowar flour, oat flour, foxtail millet flour, ragi flour), jaggery (12.5%), raw unrefined sugar (12.5%), cocoa powder, baking powder, raising agent (baking soda) [INS 500(ii)], natural flavour, iodised salt, cinnamon powder Allergen Note: Made in a facility that processes wheat and nuts. May contain trace elements. Safety Advice: Always supervise when feeding children. Cut into bite sizes to minimise choking risk.
